g.text: Headless Daemon Stream → Incremental DOM Virtual Grid → Low-Power 120Hz Mobile Display
Receives row delta packets via WSS
Auto-requests backfill from host ring buffer on sequence gap
Calculates active mobile lines (e.g. 42 visible rows)
• GPU layer promotion per row • Zero layout reflow on cursor blink
Zero-canvas power savings on mobile WebKit / Blink
